# magpie
### Every agent's model. One place.
**Claude Code on Kimi. Codex on DeepSeek. Gemini CLI on GLM. OpenCode on your ChatGPT plan.** 
Switch any of them from the menu bar. One local gateway serves them all, 
and when a quota runs out, it quietly moves on to your next account.
[ ](https://github.com/yetone/magpie-releases/releases/latest) [ ](https://github.com/yetone/magpie/stargazers) [ ](https://discord.gg/vGSnD3ZKQF) [ ](LICENSE) 
Thanks to [Kimi](https://usemagpie.ai/go/kimi/readme) for supporting magpie and the open source community.
 Sponsors 
                       
              
**[Download](https://usemagpie.ai)**  ·  **[Docs](https://usemagpie.ai/docs/start)**  ·  **[Reference](docs/reference.md)**  ·  **[Plugins](https://github.com/magpie-community/plugins)**  ·  **[Discord](https://discord.gg/vGSnD3ZKQF)**  ·  **English** · [简体中文](README.zh-CN.md)
## Is magpie for you?
Each agent keeps its model in its own file, in its own format, with its own keys and base URLs. A subscription you pay for works in one agent and nowhere else. magpie puts all of that behind one app and one local gateway:
- **Pick any model for any agent** from one list. magpie edits the one key that matters in the agent's own config.
- **Use one provider everywhere**: an API key, a local model, or the Claude, ChatGPT, Copilot, Gemini or Grok plan you're signed in to.
- **Keep going when a quota runs out**: a provider's next account takes over, and a routing group moves on to another model or provider, so the agent never sees the error. With one account and no group there is nothing to move to, and the error reaches the agent.
- **Keep your secrets off the vendor's servers**: once you turn masking on in **Settings → Privacy** (it's off by default), keys, passwords and emails in a prompt are masked on your computer before the request leaves it, and put back in the reply.
It's for you if you use more than one agent, more than one provider, or more than one account. If you use one agent on its vendor's own plan and that's enough, you don't need it.
Runs on macOS, Windows and Linux (menu bar app, window, TUI, web UI and CLI), in Docker, and on Termux.

**1 · Install.** Download the app from **[usemagpie.ai](https://usemagpie.ai)**, or run:
```sh
curl -fsSL https://usemagpie.ai/install.sh | sh
```

itens.readme:
# Agent Autoloop
**让你的命令行 Agent 在后台自己接活、自己跟进到底；平时不烦你，遇到拿不准的事才发卡片找你拍板。**
**中文** | [English](README.en.md)
[上手](#上手) · [场景模板](#拿来即用的场景模板) · [插件](#插件体系四个方向都能自由替换) · [内核](#内核的四个机制) · [文档](#更多文档)
## 它解决什么问题？
平时我们用 Claude Code、Codex 这类命令行 Agent，大多是“人守着终端用”：你输一句话，盯着它跑，等它问你下一步；一旦关掉窗口或者人走开，事情就断了。
**Agent Autoloop** 是一个极轻量的自动化中台。它把任务调度做成一个零外部依赖的**内核**，把事件来源、Agent、通知通道，甚至代码上线流水线全部拆成可随时插拔的**插件**。
- **一台电脑、一条命令就能跑。** 装在你的 Windows、Mac 或 Linux 上，不用买云服务器，也不用开放公网端口。
- **一行配置接新 Agent。** 不需要 SDK，也不需要改 Agent 源码，能接收提示词并打印最后一条回复的命令行工具都能接。
- **没有后台界面。** 需要你拍板时把卡片推到飞书、钉钉、企微、Slack、Discord 或桌面通知；想看全局进展，敲一行命令。
## 上手
支持 Windows、macOS 和 Linux。需要 Node 24 或更新、Git，以及一个已经登录的命令行 Agent；macOS/Linux 还需要 curl，不需要 GitHub 账号。也可以把[安装说明](INSTALL.md)交给你的 Agent。
Windows PowerShell：
```powershell
irm https://raw.githubusercontent.com/KKKKhazix/agent-autoloop/main/install.ps1 | iex
```
macOS / Linux：
```bash
curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/KKKKhazix/agent-autoloop/main/install.sh | sh
```
安装和 `agent-autoloop update` 都装最新的 [Release](https://github.com/KKKKhazix/agent-autoloop/releases)，那是通过了全部检查的版本。
装好后用你本机的 Agent 真实走一遍“提问 → 退出等回复 → 拍板 → 接着干完”：
```bash
agent-autoloop try
```
下面是在终端里的真实输出：
```text
事件发出去了，Agent 开始干活……
Agent 结束了这一轮，问了你一个问题。它现在不占进程、不花 Token。
【等你决定】#1 试跑：选一个颜色
这是一次试跑，选哪个都行。
  1. 蓝色
  2. 绿色
回答：agent-autoloop answer 1  
答完运行 agent-autoloop status，能看到它接着把活干完。
```
交互终端里直接输入数字回车；非交互终端运行 `agent-autoloop answer 1 2` 选择“绿色”。再跑 `agent-autoloop status`，就能看到它接上刚才的会话并显示“你选了绿色，试跑通过”，还有今天和最近 7 天的轮数、Token 和费用（[统计口径](skills/agent-autoloop/SKILL.md#看情况回答)）。
## 一件事怎么转起来
编号和上面的架构图一一对应：
1. **新事件进来。** 早上 9 点的定时任务、GitHub 上新提的 Issue、业务系统报的错，都变成一条标准事件送进内核。
2. **按规则派活。** 内核照你写的规则，决定交给哪个 Agent、去哪个目录干。同一件事排队时又来的消息，会合并成一轮处理。
3. **干完一轮就退出。** Agent 把结果写在最后一条回复里，进程直接退出。
4. **拿不准才问你。** 碰到删数据、重启服务、花钱、对外发消息这类事，内核通过飞书或桌面通知发一张卡片给你。等你回复期间，它不占后台进程，也不消耗 Token。
5. **点一下，接着干。** 你选完，它接上原来的对话，把剩下的活干完。
能自己搞定的事走图上方的自动闭环：直接办完，或者约个时间（比如半小时后）再醒来复查，全程不打扰你。
## 日常怎么配？
### 写一份规则（`rules.json`）
不需要写胶水代码。打开 `~/.agent-autoloop/rules.json`，在 `rules` 里写清楚**什么事、交给谁、在哪个目录干**。`to` 填 `agents` 里已有的名字。比如每天早上 9 点写早报：
```json
{
  "name": "早报",
  "when": { "cron": "0 9 * * *" },
  "to": "codex",
  "cwd": "~/notes",
  "prompt": "整理昨天的笔记和提交，写今天的早报。"
}
```
外部事件写法一样，只是要先接好来源。比如有人提新 Issue 时交给 Codex，先按[说明](skills/agent-autoloop/SKILL.md#接一个事件插件)在 `sources` 里登记 `github`：
```json
{
  "name": "处理 issue",
  "when": { "source": "github", "types": ["issues.opened"] },
  "to": "codex",
  "cwd": "~/code/app",
  "skill": "handle-issue",
  "parallel": 3
}
```

itens.descricao_en: 244 pixel art effects, every one a small piece of code. Plus a Claude Code skill to make your own.
itens.readme:
# pixelfx.
** 244  pixel art effects and animations, every one a small piece of code.** Fire,
explosions, magic, weather, UI, pickups, critters and more. Play them live, recolor and mirror them, drop them into
a browser game, or export sprite sheets for any engine. Plus a Claude Code skill that makes new ones the way a
picky pixel artist would: draft, render, look, refine.
Every effect that involves a character is **acted out**: he winds up, lets go, freezes on contact and recovers, and a
target takes the hit. Twelve whole moves chain the effects into attacks from wind-up to recovery.
**[open the gallery](https://patch-gg.github.io/pixelfx/)** · [catalog](docs/CATALOG.md) · [acting](#acting) ·
[the skill](#the-skill) · [make your own](#make-your-own) · [publish it on patch](#publish-it-on-patch) ·
[how it works](#how-it-works)
The method is [Hugo Duprez](https://x.com/HugoDuprez)'s, from [How to make (good) pixel art effects with
Claude](https://www.spritefusion.com/blog/how-to-make-good-pixel-art-effects-with-claude): code is clay, trust your
eyes, feed your references. His [open-source effects](https://www.spritefusion.com/pixel-art-vfx) at Sprite Fusion
set the bar, and `src/core/sim.js` and the effects that say so at the top adapt his code. This repo is our take on
the idea at library scale, with a skill to keep going.
## what's in it.
| category | effects | some of them |
|---|---|---|
| **moves** | 12 | arrow shot, dash strike, earth stomp, fireball throw, ground pound, holy smite… |
| **fire** | 12 | brazier, campfire, candle, fire breath, fire ring, fire tornado… |
| **explosions** | 12 | barrel explosion, big explosion, cartoon pow, dirt explosion, firework burst, firework rocket… |
| **water** | 12 | bubbles, drip, fountain, geyser, rain splash, ripples… |
| **ice** | 10 | blizzard vortex, freeze, frost breath, frost nova, ice crystal, ice lance… |
| **lightning** | 11 | ball lightning, chain lightning, charge up, electrified, lightning strike, plasma ball… |
| **sci-fi** | 12 | emp blast, energy core, force field, glitch, hologram, jetpack… |
| **melee** | 12 | claw swipe, dagger flurry, double slash, hammer smash, heavy cleave, scythe reap… |
| **impacts** | 11 | blunt hit, bullet impact, critical hit, ground slam, heavy landing, hit flash… |
| **projectiles** | 13 | arrow, bullet tracer, cannon shot, energy disc, signal flare, homing missile… |
| **spawn & death** | 10 | coin drop, disintegrate, dissolve burn, egg hatch, poof, respawn beam… |

⭐ *Help more people find rea-video. Star this repo!*
Left: a TikTok ad shot on a phone. Right: an AI remake with another product. rea-video's verdict: the left is all live footage, one set and two camera positions; the right is all AI, 8 shots across 3 generations.
## Quick start
rea-video is built for AI agents. In Claude Code, Codex or any agent that can run commands, say:
```text
Install https://github.com/JuneYaooo/rea-video, then break down this video: /path/to/video.mp4
```
The agent installs the CLI, learns the workflow and runs the whole thing. You need ffmpeg and Python 3.10+.
  Install by hand 
```bash
brew install ffmpeg            # or: sudo apt install ffmpeg
git clone https://github.com/JuneYaooo/rea-video && cd rea-video
bash scripts/install_skill.sh  # installs the CLI (pip, or pipx / a local .venv if pip is blocked) and links the skill into ~/.claude, ~/.codex, ~/.agents
rea-video --help
```
You get:
- a one-line summary, e.g. "41% AI video + 59% code UI, 8 s of real screen recording, library music at 122 BPM"
- a remake plan, split into what to film, what to generate and what to code
- a full `report.html` with per-shot frames, evidence, prompts, camera and lighting notes, and the audio breakdown
You can also hook up a video-capable model (Gemini or Doubao both work) by giving the agent its endpoint and key. That makes the live/AI/3D calls more accurate and adds a reverse-engineered prompt for every shot. It works fine without one; if your agent can see images, it checks the uncertain shots itself.
> Reports are written in whichever language you ask in (Chinese or English). The example reports below are in English.

| Live footage | Talking-head, tabletop, handheld product demo, vlog, store visit | Setups and camera positions, framing, camera moves, lighting (12 setups with gear lists), color grade |
| AI video | Text/image-to-video,

itens.readme:
Design with an elephant. Review with a goldfish. 
   Install   · 
   Quickstart   · 
   Documentation   · 
   Website 
Develop ideas with context and review documents with fresh eyes. EGM is an open-source plugin for AI assistants.
**Elephant** holds your project context and drafts the specification. **Goldfish** reviewers examine the draft and referenced source material without the earlier conversation, helping expose unstated assumptions and blind spots. **You** make the architectural trade-offs and approve the specification before implementing.
The built-in draft and design-review workflow targets software specifications. For other documents, choose reviewers and standards with `/egm-review-loop`. Bootstrap and drift reporting apply to software codebases.
https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/93c799a2-10a3-4266-af02-eb79dd33a9a2
## Install
Choose your coding agent. Install the complete plugin so its skills can read the reviewer prompts and document standards.
### ChatGPT and Codex desktop
Open the [published EGM plugin](https://chatgpt.com/plugins/plugins_6aeb90f47ec88191a3c107e01d3eb357) in the desktop app and install it. This listing is desktop-only. For Codex CLI, use the commands below.
### Antigravity CLI
```sh
agy plugin install https://github.com/google/elephant-goldfish-model
```
For the **Antigravity App** and **Antigravity for IDEs** (Visual Studio Code extension), run `/plugin` or see the [installation instructions](docs/harnesses.md#antigravity-app-and-antigravity-for-ides).
### Claude Code
```sh
claude plugin marketplace add google/elephant-goldfish-model
claude plugin install egm@egm
```
### Codex CLI
```sh
codex plugin marketplace add google/elephant-goldfish-model
codex plugin add egm@egm
```
Start a new session after installation. For **Claude Cowork** and **ChatGPT Work**, see the [setup guide](docs/harnesses.md).
## Try a 60-second review on existing code
Review an existing design document, README, or PR plan against the live code. You do not need to write a new specification. The commands below use the `/egm:` prefix for Antigravity (agy CLI) and Claude Code. In Codex, select the corresponding EGM skill from the skill picker.
  **Review an existing document**
```text
/egm:egm-review docs/designs/webhooks.md
```
Use the path to your design doc, or to a PR plan saved as Markdown. Fresh reviewers check the design, its clarity, its fit with the code, and its implementation plan.
  **Check for drift**

itens.readme:
# stack-diagram
[ ](https://github.com/caru-ini/stack-diagram/releases/latest)
[ ](LICENSE)
[ ](https://skills.sh/caru-ini/stack-diagram)
Describe your stack in a sentence. Get an architecture diagram with official logos.
> Diagram our stack: Next.js and a Hono API on Vercel. Postgres on Neon, auth with Clerk, payments with Stripe. GitHub Actions deploys.
```bash
npx skills add caru-ini/stack-diagram
```
Works with Claude Code, Codex, Cursor and [other agents that support skills](https://agentskills.io). In the Claude apps, upload `stack-diagram.zip` from [Releases](https://github.com/caru-ini/stack-diagram/releases/latest) as a skill.
## More examples
        Dev tooling, not just clouds  
       Draw our monorepo tooling: a pnpm workspace with Turborepo, Biome, Vitest and Lefthook. GitHub Actions runs CI and publishes to npm. 
        AI apps  
       Draw our docs chatbot: Next.js on Vercel searches Supabase pgvector and answers with Claude. Inngest syncs Notion every night. 
        AWS, with AWS's own icons  
       Draw our app on AWS: CloudFront in front of S3 and an ALB in a public subnet. Fargate, RDS and ElastiCache sit in a private subnet. 
        Google Cloud, with Google's own icons  
       Draw our app on Google Cloud: a global load balancer in front of Cloud Storage and GKE. GKE, Cloud SQL and Memorystore run in one region of a VPC. 
        Azure, with Microsoft's own icons  
       Draw our app on Azure: Front Door in front of Blob Storage and App Service. App Service reaches Azure SQL and Managed Redis through private endpoints in a VNet. 
## Light and dark
Every diagram is rendered in both themes. Tiles stay white so logos keep their own colors, and group labels switch to the brand's dark-theme logo.
## Share it as an artifact
The diagram is one HTML file with its fonts and logos inlined, so it renders anywhere without a network. Publish it as a Claude artifact and share the link, or drop it into a repo or wiki. The PNGs and the React component are rendered from the same file.
## Share it to the gallery
After drawing, the agent offers once to post the diagram to the public gallery at https://stacks.caru.moe. It shows what will be public (the light and dark PNGs, an English title, the tech stack and a display name) and posts only after you say yes twice. Your prompt is never sent. A GitHub login is optional and never shown; it only lets you delete the post later. The site's source is in [`site/`](site).
## What you get
- **Official logo

itens.descricao_en: Point Claude at any game. Skills, tools and the fal MCP that let Claude Code mod almost any PC game you own: recon, reverse engineering, fal-generated art/3D/audio, in-game testing, showcase videos.
itens.readme:
Skills, tools and a shared knowledge base that let any AI coding agent mod almost any PC game you own.  
  The agent finds the game, works out the engine and the route, reads the real code, builds the mod, makes art, 3D and sound
  with  fal , tests it in the running game, cuts the video, and writes down what it learned for the next agent.
  Coming next: the mod hub at  universalmodder.com .  Publish your mods, remix other people's, and make new ones. 
  Share what you make, get help, and follow along: 
## Install
Pick your agent. Each gets the same skills (Agent Skills format), the fal MCP server, and the `um` CLI.
| Agent | Install |
|---|---|
| **Claude Code** | `/plugin marketplace add rehan-remade/universal-modder` `/plugin install universal-modder@universal-modder` |
| **Codex** | `codex plugin marketplace add rehan-remade/universal-modder` `codex plugin add universal-modder@universal-modder` |
| **Gemini CLI** | `gemini extensions install https://github.com/rehan-remade/universal-modder` |
| **VS Code / Copilot** | Enable `chat.plugins.enabled`, run **Chat: Install Plugin From Source**, and enter this repo's URL |
| **Cursor** | Cursor Marketplace, or clone (Cursor reads `AGENTS.md` and `.cursor/mcp.json`) |
| **OpenCode** | Clone and run `opencode` inside it (`opencode.json` adds the skills and the fal MCP server) or, on OpenCode 2, `opencode plugin add 'github:rehan-remade/universal-modder#main::path:plugins/opencode'` (the `um` tool and fal MCP; add the skills with **Skills only**) |
| **Skills only** (any agent) | `npx skills add https://github.com/rehan-remade/universal-modder` |
| **Anything else** | `git clone https://github.com/rehan-remade/universal-modder` and start your agent inside it |
Inside a clone, each agent finds the skills where it looks for them: `.agents/skills` (Codex, Gemini CLI,
Copilot, Cursor, OpenCode) and `.claude/skills` (Claude Code) are copies of `skills/`. Instructions are in
`AGENTS.md`, which `CLAUDE.md` and `GEMINI.md` point to. MCP config is in `.mcp.json`, `.codex/config.toml`,
`.cursor/mcp.json`, `.vscode/mcp.json` and `opencode.json` (which also points OpenCode at `skills/`).
Without a clone, OpenCode 2 installs the plugin in `plugins/opencode/` with `opencode plugin add`: one
`um_run` tool that passes its arguments straight to the CLI and runs `um` from PATH (see below), plus the
fal MCP server when `FAL_KEY` is set and none is configured. A clone doesn't need it. See
`plugins/opencode/README.md`.
**The `um` C
